# Wave 1 (singleton Task 1): initial CR, repair, SR then CR, fold

**Checkout:** `/workspace/project` is both the implementation worktree and the branch checkout. All reviews here are post-integration, so `FD_ROOT=/workspace/project`. No spec-review snapshots are needed.

**Review source:** `BASE_SHA: 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111` and `HEAD_SHA: WORKTREE`. Both stay fixed through every re-review. `WAVE_BASE_SHA` stays fixed until the commit.

## 1. Before the initial CR: stage and capture tree T_CR1

```bash
git -C /workspace/project add -A
```

Then run the fix-delta tree block with `FD_ROOT='/workspace/project'`:

```bash
FD_ROOT='/workspace/project'
FD_INDEX=$(mktemp) || exit 1
cp "$(git -C "$FD_ROOT" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path index)" "$FD_INDEX" || { rm -f "$FD_INDEX"; exit 1; }
GIT_INDEX_FILE="$FD_INDEX" git -C "$FD_ROOT" add -A && GIT_INDEX_FILE="$FD_INDEX" git -C "$FD_ROOT" write-tree
FD_STATUS=$?
rm -f "$FD_INDEX"
exit "$FD_STATUS"
```

- Record the printed SHA as **T_CR1**, keyed to wave 1 (CR).
- On a nonzero exit, stop review dispatch and report the shell error.

## 2. Initial CR (CR review 1, no sentinel)

```ts
subagent({ agent: "code-reviewer", async: false, cwd: "/workspace/project",
  task: `<code-reviewer.md filled>
DESCRIPTION: Task 1 summary from implementer report
PLAN_OR_REQUIREMENTS: <full Task 1 text>
BASE_SHA: 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
HEAD_SHA: WORKTREE
SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS: node --test tests/parse.test.mjs
Ask: production-ready?` })
```

The supplied report is `FIX_FIRST` with one Moderate finding and `Behaviour-change: yes`. This is review 1 with issues, so fix 1 follows.

There is no fan-out:
- The source precondition applies, because this is an integrated wave before its accepted-wave commit.
- There is only one finding.

## 3. Repair dispatch (one plain in-place worker)

```ts
subagent({ agent: "implementer", async: false, cwd: "/workspace/project",
  task: `<full Task 1 text + Tests: block + Spec: anchors /workspace/project/doc/specs/numbers.md:8-10>
## Code review report (verbatim)
Verdict: FIX_FIRST
Moderate: src/parse.mjs accepts an empty string as zero; reject it and add coverage in tests/error.test.mjs.
Behaviour-change: yes
SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS: node --test tests/parse.test.mjs
<status protocol: DONE | DONE_WITH_CONCERNS | BLOCKED | NEEDS_CONTEXT>` })
```

- The payload contains no commit or staging instruction.
- The worker returns `DONE` and reports a commit at `2222222222222222222222222222222222222222`.
- That moved HEAD is harmless:
  - The fix delta is tree-to-tree, so worker commits do not affect it.
  - `HEAD_SHA: WORKTREE` diffs the current checkout against 1111, which still covers the commit.
  - Never substitute a SHA range such as `1111..2222`.
- The scoped gate rerun passes:

```bash
(cd "/workspace/project" && node --test tests/parse.test.mjs)
```

## 4. SR first (Behaviour-change: yes reroute)

Stage, then capture **T_SR** by running the same tree block with `FD_ROOT='/workspace/project'`:

```bash
git -C /workspace/project add -A
```

Produce the repair-only delta, relative to the initial CR's tree:

```bash
git -C /workspace/project diff --binary <T_CR1> <T_SR>
```

This delta should contain only the `src/parse.mjs` fix and the new `tests/error.test.mjs`.

**SR ordinal:** the initial SR was review 1, so this is **SR review 2**. It is dispatched as a first-review shape: no `## Previous review report` marker, so no `TRAJECTORY:` line. SR runs against the current integrated worktree.

```ts
subagent({ agent: "spec-reviewer", async: false, cwd: "/workspace/project",
  task: `<full Task 1 text>
Spec: /workspace/project/doc/specs/numbers.md:8-10 (read the anchored ranges yourself)
<Tests: block verbatim>
Test paths: tests/parse.test.mjs, tests/error.test.mjs
Diff: integrated wave diff vs 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111 (hunks carry file:line); read every touched file in full; read deleted files from 1111...; never run tests.
## Fix delta
<output of git diff --binary <T_CR1> <T_SR>>` })
```

The supplied verdict is `COMPLIANT`, so SR is clean.

## 5. CR re-review (CR review 2)

Stage, then capture **T_CR2** with the same tree block:

```bash
git -C /workspace/project add -A
```

Produce the delta from the prior CR's dispatch tree to this one:

```bash
git -C /workspace/project diff --binary <T_CR1> <T_CR2>
```

```ts
subagent({ agent: "code-reviewer", async: false, cwd: "/workspace/project",
  task: `<code-reviewer.md filled: same DESCRIPTION/PLAN>
BASE_SHA: 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
HEAD_SHA: WORKTREE
SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS: node --test tests/parse.test.mjs
## Previous review report (re-review trigger)
Verdict: FIX_FIRST
Moderate: src/parse.mjs accepts an empty string as zero; reject it and add coverage in tests/error.test.mjs.
Behaviour-change: yes
<trajectory block from code-quality-reviewer-prompt.md, verbatim>
## Fix delta
<output of git diff --binary <T_CR1> <T_CR2>>` })
```

The supplied verdict is `SHIP`, which is clean:
- The loop ends.
- No `TRAJECTORY:` line is expected.
- No Minors are carried, since this is not the whole-diff review.

## 6. Fold and commit (only now, after SR COMPLIANT and CR SHIP)

```bash
git -C /workspace/project reset --soft "1111111111111111111111111111111111111111" && git -C /workspace/project add -A && git -C /workspace/project commit -m "Task 1: parse numbers; reject empty string"
```

- The soft reset folds the worker's commit 2222 into one durable wave commit.
- If the commit is empty, stop instead of completing the task.
- The tree must end clean.

Then mark the task complete:

```ts
plan_tracker({ action: "update", index: <Task 1 index>, status: "complete" })
```

Task 1 stayed `in_progress` through the repair and both reviews until this commit.

## What an empty repair delta would mean

An empty delta is `git diff --binary <T_CR1> <T_SR>` printing nothing. That includes repairs that touched only ignored files, and it can happen even though the worker created commit 2222.

It means the fix changed no tracked file, so the review finding is unaddressed. In that case:
1. Dispatch **no** SR or CR re-review.
2. Count it as a failed attempt under "When a Subagent Fails".
3. Resend the prior CR report verbatim with "your fix changed no tracked file".
4. Stop after the existing two-attempt limit.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.text:
Below are the next commands and payloads, **not executed actions**. Expand `TASK_1_TEXT` and `TESTS_CONTRACT` with the available verbatim task and contract; do not replace them with summaries.

### 1. Stage and record the initial CR tree

Run in a persistent shell. Each capture runs the required scratch-index block; stop on any error.

```bash
git -C /workspace/project add -A || exit 1

CR_BEFORE=$(
  FD_ROOT=/workspace/project
  FD_INDEX=$(mktemp) || exit 1
  cp "$(git -C "$FD_ROOT" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path index)" "$FD_INDEX" || { rm -f "$FD_INDEX"; exit 1; }
  GIT_INDEX_FILE="$FD_INDEX" git -C "$FD_ROOT" add -A && GIT_INDEX_FILE="$FD_INDEX" git -C "$FD_ROOT" write-tree
  FD_STATUS=$?
  rm -f "$FD_INDEX"
  exit "$FD_STATUS"
) || exit 1
printf 'wave1 initial-CR tree: %s\n' "$CR_BEFORE"
```

Dispatch, without committing:

```js
subagent({
  agent: "code-reviewer",
  async: false,
  cwd: "/workspace/project",
  task: `Review production readiness using the supplied code-reviewer template.
DESCRIPTION: Task 1 integrated implementation: src/parse.mjs and tests/parse.test.mjs.
PLAN_OR_REQUIREMENTS:
${TASK_1_TEXT}
${TESTS_CONTRACT}
Spec: /workspace/project/doc/specs/numbers.md:8-10
BASE_SHA: 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
HEAD_SHA: WORKTREE
SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS: node --test tests/parse.test.mjs
Read the staged and unstaged checkout against BASE_SHA. Do not edit files.`
})
```

The review source is `git diff --binary 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111 -- .`, **not** a committed range.

### 2. Repair after the supplied FIX_FIRST report

Use one in-place worker, not a nested worktree or fan-out:

```js
subagent({
  agent: "implementer",
  async: false,
  cwd: "/workspace/project",
  task: `Repair Task 1 in place.
${TASK_1_TEXT}
${TESTS_CONTRACT}
Spec: /workspace/project/doc/specs/numbers.md:8-10
SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS: node --test tests/parse.test.mjs

Prior review report, verbatim:
Verdict: FIX_FIRST
Moderate: src/parse.mjs accepts an empty string as zero; reject it and add coverage in tests/error.test.mjs.
Behaviour-change: yes

Verify the finding, repair it, and self-review. Return explicitly
DONE, DONE_WITH_CONCERNS, NEEDS_CONTEXT, or BLOCKED, with test-contract evidence.`
})
```

Given the supplied `DONE` and worker commit at `2222222222222222222222222222222222222222`, retain the original wave base. Do **not** reset yet.

```bash
(cd /workspace/project && node --test tests/parse.test.mjs) || exit 1
git -C /workspace/project add -A || exit 1

SR_AFTER=$(
  FD_ROOT=/workspace/project
  FD_INDEX=$(mktemp) || exit 1
  cp "$(git -C "$FD_ROOT" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path index)" "$FD_INDEX" || { rm -f "$FD_INDEX"; exit 1; }
  GIT_INDEX_FILE="$FD_INDEX" git -C "$FD_ROOT" add -A && GIT_INDEX_FILE="$FD_INDEX" git -C "$FD_ROOT" write-tree
  FD_STATUS=$?
  rm -f "$FD_INDEX"
  exit "$FD_STATUS"
) || exit 1
printf 'task1 repair-SR tree: %s\n' "$SR_AFTER"
FIX_DELTA=$(git -C /workspace/project diff --binary "$CR_BEFORE" "$SR_AFTER") || exit 1
```

This delta isolates the repair, including new `tests/error.test.mjs`, regardless of the worker commit.

### 3. Behavior-change gate: SR first

```js
subagent({
  agent: "spec-reviewer",
  async: false,
  cwd: "/workspace/project",
  task: `Task 1, next SR ordinal:
${TASK_1_TEXT}
${TESTS_CONTRACT}
Spec: /workspace/project/doc/specs/numbers.md:8-10
- Test: tests/parse.test.mjs
- Test: tests/error.test.mjs

## Fix delta
${FIX_DELTA}

Review the behavior-changing repair against the anchored specification.
Start from diff hunks; read every touched file in full from this checkout.
Read deleted files from 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111 if needed.
Never run tests.`
})
```

This is the rerouted SR’s first review of the repair: **no previous-report marker and no trajectory requirement**.

After the supplied `COMPLIANT`, stage and capture the CR tree:

```bash
git -C /workspace/project add -A || exit 1
CR_AFTER=$(
  FD_ROOT=/workspace/project
  FD_INDEX=$(mktemp) || exit 1
  cp "$(git -C "$FD_ROOT" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path index)" "$FD_INDEX" || { rm -f "$FD_INDEX"; exit 1; }
  GIT_INDEX_FILE="$FD_INDEX" git -C "$FD_ROOT" add -A && GIT_INDEX_FILE="$FD_INDEX" git -C "$FD_ROOT" write-tree
  FD_STATUS=$?
  rm -f "$FD_INDEX"
  exit "$FD_STATUS"
) || exit 1
FIX_DELTA=$(git -C /workspace/project diff --binary "$CR_BEFORE" "$CR_AFTER") || exit 1
```

Dispatch CR with the same requirements, commands, base, and `HEAD_SHA: WORKTREE`, plus:

```text
## Fix delta
<insert FIX_DELTA verbatim>

## Previous review report (re-review trigger)
Verdict: FIX_FIRST
Moderate: src/parse.mjs accepts an empty string as zero; reject it and add coverage in tests/error.test.mjs.
Behaviour-change: yes
```

Append the supplied **Code Quality Reviewer Prompt Template → “Re-review: trajectory verdict” block verbatim**, including its sentinel formats and ordered classification rules.

### 4. Only after the supplied SHIP

```bash
git -C /workspace/project reset --soft 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111 &&
git -C /workspace/project add -A &&
git -C /workspace/project commit -m "Implement number parsing with empty-input rejection"
```

Only on successful, nonempty commit:

```js
plan_tracker({ action: "update", index: 1, status: "complete" })
```

An empty repair delta means no tracked repair occurred: dispatch **no re-review**; count a failed attempt, resend the prior report with “your fix changed no tracked file,” and apply the existing two-attempt limit. Stop here, at wave completion.

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After keeps every fact Before kept: BASE_SHA 1111/HEAD_SHA WORKTREE on both CRs with add -A staging first; scratch-index tree captures T_CR1/T_SR/T_CR2 with git diff --binary between tree objects covering only the parse.mjs fix and new tests/error.test.mjs; one plain in-place implementer in /workspace/project with the report verbatim and no commit/staging instruction; Behaviour-change: yes routed to SR against the integrated checkout with Spec anchors, Tests block and Fix delta before CR re-review; scoped-only gate; reset --soft to WAVE_BASE_SHA, add -A, commit, then plan_tracker complete only after COMPLIANT and SHIP. Two small wording regressions worth restoring: Before explicitly said it never substitutes a working-tree diff for the tree delta, while After only names the SHA-range substitution — add 'nor a working-tree diff' to the 'Never substitute' bullet. Also the SR task's 'Diff: integrated wave diff vs 1111…' line sits next to the '## Fix delta' block and could read as a second review source; phrase it as the reviewer's reading context ('for whole-file reads, diff the integrated checkout against 1111…; the Fix delta below is the repair-only scope') to keep it clearly distinct from the tree-to-tree delta. Finally, Before's empty-delta section ended with 'the task stays in_progress pending a human decision'; since the Change makes that D1 lifecycle explicit at exhausted retries, re-add that sentence after step 4 of After's empty-delta list.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: Nothing moved: After keeps every fact Before kept while delivering the Change. Both outputs use BASE_SHA 1111… with HEAD_SHA WORKTREE for the initial and repeated CR after the worker's commit at 2222…, stage with add -A before each review, review the whole staged/unstaged checkout rather than a commit range, capture CR-before/SR-after/CR-after trees with the seeded scratch GIT_INDEX_FILE block and diff --binary between tree objects (After explicitly names tests/error.test.mjs in the delta), dispatch one plain in-place implementer with the verbatim report and no commit/staging or leave-uncommitted instruction, route the Behaviour-change repair through SR against /workspace/project with task text, Tests contract, anchors and Fix delta before CR, treat an empty delta as a failed attempt with no re-review, and only after COMPLIANT and SHIP run reset --soft to the wave base, add -A, commit, then mark Task 1 complete. Two minor hazards worth tightening in After: the SR payload appends synthetic '- Test:' lines for both test files after TESTS_CONTRACT, which risks reading as an amended contract rather than the original one (drop them or label them as deliverables), and the CR re-review is described as 'same requirements, commands, base, and HEAD_SHA: WORKTREE' instead of a full payload—spelling out the complete subagent call as Before does would make the WORKTREE/BASE_SHA reuse unambiguous to a stricter reader.
